name: AccountReportingRequest
label: Account Reporting Request
summary: Asks the bank to send an account report or statement. The pull half of cash reporting, where camt.052 and camt.053 are the push.
whenUsed: On-demand balance checks, re-requesting a statement that never arrived, or backfilling a gap found in the sequence numbers. Replaces MT920. Also used to set up or amend a standing reporting subscription, depending on the bank's offering.
gotchas: ReqdMsgNmId is what selects the reply type — camt.052.001.08 for an intraday report, camt.053.001.08 for a statement. Asking for the wrong one is the usual reason a request 'returns nothing useful'.
Banks commonly restrict how far back you can request and how often you may ask. Re-requesting a two-month-old statement in a retry loop will be throttled or refused.
The response arrives as a separate message with its own identifiers, and there is no status message in between. If nothing comes back you have no error to inspect — build a timeout, not a wait.

fields.name: Message Sender
fields.note: Who is asking, where that differs from the account owner.

fields.name: Reporting Request
fields.note: One per account and report type requested.

fields.name: Requested Message Name Identification
fields.note: Which message you want back, e.g. camt.053.001.08. Mandatory, and the single most important element here.

fields.name: Account
fields.note: Which account. Omitting it asks for every account you are entitled to see, which some banks refuse.

fields.name: Account Currency
fields.note: Needed to pick one currency of a multi-currency account.

fields.name: Account Owner
fields.note: Mandatory. The bank uses it to check entitlement.

fields.name: Reporting Period
fields.note: The window you want covered. Omit for 'as at now'.

fields.name: From To Time
fields.note: Time-of-day bounds, which matter for intraday reports.

fields.name: Type
fields.note: Whether the period is interpreted against booking date or value date — the same window gives different entries either way.

fields.name: Reporting Sequence
fields.note: Request by statement sequence number instead of by date. The right tool for filling a detected gap.

fields.name: Requested Transaction Type
fields.note: Filter by entry status, credit/debit, or floor amount — ask for only what you need.

fields.name: Floor Limit
fields.note: Suppress entries below a threshold. The MT field 34F position — note that in ISO the limit lives in the request, so the report no longer records what threshold produced it.

fields.name: Requested Balance Type
fields.note: Restrict which balance types come back.
